<jats:title>A<jats:sc>bstract</jats:sc>
                     </jats:title><jats:p>In this note, we prove combinatorial formulas for the Hodge number <jats:italic>h</jats:italic><jats:sup>2<jats:italic>,</jats:italic>1</jats:sup> of prime toric divisors in an arbitrary toric hypersurface Calabi-Yau fourfold <jats:italic>Y</jats:italic><jats:sub>4</jats:sub>. We show that it is possible to find a toric hypersurface Calabi-Yau in which there are more than <jats:italic>h</jats:italic><jats:sup>1,1</jats:sup>(<jats:italic>Y</jats:italic><jats:sub>4</jats:sub>) non-perturbative superpotential terms with trivial intermediate Jacobian. Hodge numbers of divisors in toric complete intersection Calabi-Yaus are the subjects of the sequel.</jats:p>
title: A note on h2,1 of divisors in CY fourfolds. Part I
